comparison.objective: Carry a long thin panel to a rack without excessive bow; candidate finishes installed thread inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Selecting support points and synchronizing a distributed bimanual lift versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammering, and tiny-fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Panel placed on rack rail while bow remains below the damaging regime versus four tang fractures with no insert/shell damage and full containment.
comparison.reason: The panel task centers on deformation-aware support placement, not localized impact and fracture. No separate spec versions were provided.
